name: Other playback complaints
definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

name: Excessive Ad Interruptions
definition: Free listening is interrupted by ads too frequently or with disruptive volume, making continuous music playback difficult.

name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

name: Other catalog complaints
definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)

name: Premium-Gated Playback Controls
definition: Basic playback controls such as playing the next or previous song, queueing tracks, or seeking within a song are unavailable without Premium.

name: Forced Shuffle on Free Tier
definition: Free users are unable to directly choose and play a specific song because playback is forced into shuffle or a playlist.

name: Missing Playback Controls
definition: Updates remove or restrict controls such as seeking, repeating, or playing a specific part of a song.

name: Other access complaints
definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

name: Update degraded app experience
definition: Complaints that a recent update made the app worse, disappointing, or unusable belong here.

name: Other downloads complaints
definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

name: Other billing complaints
definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

name: Disruptive Home Screen Changes
definition: Home screen redesigns and automatically playing interface elements make browsing difficult or lack clear controls to disable them.

name: Unwanted Random Playlist Playback
definition: Playlist playback is shuffled or randomized when listeners expect songs to play in their chosen order.

name: Excessive app restrictions
definition: Complaints that restrictions in the app are too limiting belong here.

name: Rude customer support
definition: Complaints that Spotify app support staff behave rudely belong here.
